notes.title: Vanguard Princess Mobile (PC Port) Demo Now Playable in Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
[h3]Get ready, fighters! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3473100/Vanguard_Princess_Mobile_PC_Port_Demo/]Vanguard Princess Mobile (PC Port)[/url] has joined Steam Next Fest: February 2025 Edition, bringing a playable PC demo to Steam from February 24 to March 3, 2025. Originally designed for Android, the game is expanding to iOS, PC, Mac, and Linux, featuring touch controls, gamepad support, and rollback netcode for smooth online battles.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5637861/f005344fc795640af1da969e9a4dc33d4de4d254.png[/img]

[h3]This special demo introduces 10 classic characters, new stages, additional music, and AI-powered enemy decision-making using Fuzzy Logic. Your feedback will help refine the game and shape the upcoming [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/eigomanga/vanguard-princess-mobile-fighting-game]Kickstarter crowdfunding campaign[/url].[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5637861/6adbef8e53317e0d45f56a6d1606f18313339bc4.png[/img]

[h2][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3473100/Vanguard_Princess_Mobile_PC_Port_Demo/]Try the demo now and help us build the best Vanguard Princess Mobile experience![/url][/h2]

[h2][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/eigomanga/vanguard-princess-mobile-fighting-game]Support the Kickstarter
[/url][/h2]

notes.title: Vanguard Princess Comic Series
notes.content:
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/857390/][b][i]Vanguard Princess Comic Series[/i][/b][/url] launches as an exclusive Steam DLC on Monday, May 7, 2018.

This is an original comic series based off the [b][i]Vanguard Princess[/i][/b] game.

Follow the journey of a group of young women gifted with special abilities were recruited and militarized to help usher in a new era of world peace.

[b][u]Features:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]   Original comic series exclusive to Steam
[*]   Free updates for new chapter releases
[*]   PDF digital format to read on other devices
[*]   [b][u]BONUS:[/u][/b] A collection of hi-res artwork[/list]

notes.title: Vanguard Princess Is Now Available For Linux
notes.content:
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/262150][img]http://www.eigomanga.com/vanguard/steam/vp_linux_steam.png[/img][/url]

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/262150][b][i]Vanguard Princess[/i][/b][/url] officially launches on [b]Linux[/b] and [b]SteamOS[/b]. This updated version delivers all of the features offered in the PC and Mac OS X version.

In addition, the [b]Linux[/b] version provides players with all of the game's previously released downloadable content for Windows PC and Mac OS X, including additional playable characters, battle stages, story-driven content, and [b][u]built-in arcade stick support[/u][/b] at no additional cost.

The following items are immediately accessible at launch for players who purchase [b][i]
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/262150]Vanguard Princess[/url][/i] for Linux[/b] with no additional charges:

[list]
    [*]Updated and originally uncensored version of [b][i]Vanguard Princess[/i][/b]
    [*]Access to playable versions of the game's boss character [b]Hilda Rize[/b]
    [*]Additional battle stages
    [*]Alternate story-lines
    [*]Alternate endings for various characters
    [*]Additional in-game music
    [*]Built-in arcade stick support[/list]

[url]http://store.steampowered.com/app/262150/[/url]

notes.title: Game Update: One Button Super Attack
notes.content:
We made updates to all versions of Vanguard Princess to make the "One Button/Key Super Attack" more known to beginners.

Instead of using two keys or buttons to activate a Super Attack or Parry, gamers can use one button or key; this was already known to long time Vanguard Princess gamers.

There are interfaces and graphics throughout the game to help gamers become aware of it.

Like all other controls in the game, the one button super/parry can be reconfigured on keyboards and gamepads to better suit gamers' needs.

The update is available now.
